headline: Argentine Central Bank Resumes Dollar Purchases, Acquiring USD 9 Million
summary: Argentina's monetary authority purchased USD 9 million in the foreign exchange market following a start to November without official purchases, bringing international reserves close to USD 50.5 billion.
why: Central bank foreign exchange accumulation is a primary metric for assessing Argentina's monetary stability and compliance with reserve accumulation targets.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Central bank reserve accumulation strengthens external liquidity buffers.
